# PaperPolyhedra fixtures

Reference exports from the Processing version, one folder per shape: `fold.svg` (cut file),
`print.pdf` (print file) and `params.json` (the inputs and the PaperPrototyping commit).

Generated by `node scripts/fixtures/paperpolyhedra/generate.mjs`, which runs a copy of the
sketch with `scripts/fixtures/paperpolyhedra/FixtureHarness.pde`. Edit `shapes.json` there
to add shapes, then regenerate. Do not edit these files by hand.

Inputs follow the Processing UI: `topDiameter`/`bottomDiameter` are the side length for
4 sides and the circumscribed diameter otherwise.
